title: Fillet corner sphere/cylinder boundaries weld cleanly
summary: tessellate_small_spherical_cap took the topology's 3-vertex boundary loop literally — its first ring stitched to those 3 chord endpoints while the adjacent cylinder caps sampled their v-arc at ~9 points around the same 90° great circle. The mismatched sample positions stayed un-welded and creased_normals couldn't average normals across the seam. Densify the sphere cap's boundary along its great-circle arcs at circle_segments density first, so cylinder cap samples and sphere boundary samples land on identical 3D points and the smoothing pass averages cleanly across the tangent edge.
